sequence.subject: Your ClinicPlus Companion access is ready
sequence.preview: Use your existing ClinicPlus login and claim 100 free credits when you try the new booking companion.
sequence.headline: Book repeat medicals without retyping your roster
sequence.intro: We built ClinicPlus Companion for teams who book the same employees again and again.
body: Instead of typing employee details from scratch each time, you can save a roster once, reuse job specs, select services in bulk, and create a real ClinicPlus appointment from one dashboard.
Because you are an existing ClinicPlus client, your invitation includes 100 free credits when you log in from this email for the first time.
bullets: Save employee names, ID/passport numbers, occupations, sites, and job specs
Build appointments from saved employees instead of spreadsheets
Track credits, bookings, and basic appointment insights

sequence.subject: The part that saves the most time
sequence.preview: Your roster becomes reusable: employees, services, sites, and job specs stay ready for the next booking.
sequence.headline: Your next bulk booking can start from a saved roster
sequence.intro: The biggest time drain in repeat medical bookings is not choosing the clinic. It is rebuilding the same employee list.
body: ClinicPlus Companion keeps the employee details you need for recurring occupational health appointments in one place, then lets you choose the people you need when a new booking comes up.
It is especially useful for mine medicals, inductions, exit medicals, and teams that move between sites.
bullets: Group employees by crew, department, site, or occupation
Reuse uploaded job spec files where they already exist
See the appointment record after it is created in ClinicPlus

sequence.subject: Last reminder: your 100 credits are waiting
sequence.preview: Use the invite link before your team’s next booking cycle and see whether Companion fits your workflow.
sequence.headline: Make the next booking cycle lighter
sequence.intro: A saved roster is easiest to set up before the next urgent booking request lands.
body: Log in with your existing ClinicPlus account, claim the 100-credit invite bonus, and add a few employees to see how the flow feels.
If Companion saves your team even one round of repeated typing, it has already done its first job.
bullets: Credits are visible before priced actions run
You stay in control of what gets submitted
